**Exploring shell globstar functionality**

Wow, I’m discovering that shell globstar can handle paths across multiple levels — maybe even up to five levels. I can use the command `shopt -s globstar nullglob; for f in **/*.go; do ...` to work with it. I realize this isn't exactly a search command like `find`, but it’s a neat way to match files. This expands my understanding of how globbing can help me navigate directories!
